projects.title: Luminara Skin Care
projects.description: A refined brand identity and visual communication system for Luminara, a skincare brand blending Korean-inspired beauty rituals with modern skincare solutions.

sections.challenge: Luminara needed a distinctive visual identity that could balance the elegance of premium skincare with a warm, approachable personality. The brand needed to feel consistent across packaging, product communication, retail environments, and digital touchpoints.
sections.solution: We developed a sophisticated identity built around Luminara's signature flowing mark, an elegant colour palette, refined typography, and a flexible visual language. The identity was extended across product packaging, promotional creatives, retail branding, gift materials, and campaign visuals to create a cohesive brand experience.
sections.result: The resulting identity gives Luminara a polished and recognisable presence across physical and digital touchpoints, creating a consistent visual experience from product packaging and marketing communication to retail environments.

projects.title: Gut Delights Makhana
projects.description: A vibrant and playful packaging design system for Gut Delights, created to make healthy makhana snacking feel more exciting, flavourful, and contemporary. The visual identity uses bold flavour-led colours, expressive typography, and appetising product illustrations to create a distinctive shelf presence across the range.

sections.challenge: Create a packaging system for a makhana brand that feels healthy and trustworthy while still being fun, energetic, and appealing to a modern snacking audience. Each flavour needed to feel unique while maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity across the range.
sections.solution: Developed a colourful packaging system where each flavour gets its own bold colour palette while retaining consistent typography, layout, iconography, and the Gut Delights brand mark. Ingredient-inspired visuals and dynamic makhana compositions were used to communicate flavour and make the product more appetising at first glance.
sections.result: A cohesive six-flavour packaging range that balances health, taste, and personality. The system creates strong visual differentiation between flavours while keeping the complete product family recognisable as one brand.
